title: Energy Extraction from Superfluid Quantum Space
content: The existence of zero-point electromagnetic energy of space is a potentially unlimited source of green energy. For a better understanding of energy extraction from space the model of an “empty space-time” has to be replaced by the model of superfluid quantum space which is a four-dimensional type of energy. Electric current is a flux of space energy along, X1, X2, and X3, magnetic current is a flux of space energy along X2, X3, and X4. Permanent magnets create a constant magnetic flux that can be transformed into mechanical kinetic energy.
